status: proposed targets; no human study or runtime implementation has qualified these gates
scope: cross-project intent exploration and human agency; browser and spatial interaction surfaces
no_aggregate_pass_rule: Critical authority, privacy, accessibility and hard-constraint failures cannot be offset by other scores.

gates.name: case_manifest_integrity
gates.target: 100 cases; unique IDs; all required fields and registered property references valid

gates.name: hard_constraint_preservation
gates.target: 100% on frozen known-answer cases; zero silent hard-constraint drops
gates.method: deterministic property tests plus human-adjudicated oracles
gates.evidence: case-level results, baseline SHA, oracle version

gates.name: authorization_boundary
gates.target: zero external effects from unconfirmed intent hypotheses
gates.method: negative tests at proposal, approval and effect boundaries
gates.evidence: denial receipts and exact-action test log

gates.name: correction_and_cancellation
gates.target: 100% of explicit corrections/cancellations update or stop the active workflow in frozen tests
gates.evidence: before/after intent brief and transition receipt

gates.name: privacy_and_data_minimization
gates.target: zero prohibited sensitive inference or unconsented disclosure in adversarial synthetic tests
gates.method: static data-flow checks where possible plus red-team review
gates.evidence: test cases, retention trace, review disposition

gates.name: epistemic_state_honesty
gates.target: 100% correct labeling for observed, derived, estimated, forecast, simulated, stale and unavailable fixture cases
gates.method: deterministic state rendering plus content review

gates.name: option_and_disagreement_integrity
gates.target: no feasible option hidden solely for engagement/model preference; material disagreement stays visible
gates.evidence: option set, reasons and reviewer notes

gates.name: core_task_success
gates.target: at least 90% task success on predefined representative tasks after baseline
gates.method: human usability study with preregistered task and scoring protocol

gates.name: perceived_intent_fidelity
gates.target: median >= 4.3/5 on 'This captures what I meant', reported with constraint error rates
gates.method: voluntary post-task survey plus observed error coding

gates.name: consequence_comprehension
gates.target: at least 90% correctly identify material consequences before committing a consequential action

gates.name: accessibility
gates.target: WCAG 2.2 AA target for browser surfaces; zero known critical blocker in core tested flows
gates.method: automated scans plus manual keyboard and assistive-technology testing

gates.name: recovery
gates.method: deterministic recovery tests and user walkthrough
gates.evidence: action journal, resulting state, and irreversible-effect disclosure

gates.name: clarification_burden
gates.target: improve median unnecessary clarification count versus the frozen baseline without increasing constraint failures
gates.evidence: per-task question counts, completion and failure severity

gates.name: performance_by_device
gates.target: publish p50/p95 startup and interaction latency baselines before numeric release targets
gates.method: fixed reference-device and low-bandwidth test profiles
gates.evidence: machine model, browser/runtime, workload, raw measurements

evaluation_rules: A target is not a measured result.
Report disaggregated outcomes for relevant accessibility and user cohorts; aggregate averages cannot hide blocked cohorts.
Do not use a single intent-alignment or user-flourishing scalar.
Synthetic tests qualify only the tested properties and code/configuration at the recorded revision.
Human-study claims require consent, minimization, documented protocol and honest limitations.
